title: Quantum obstructions for $N=1$ infinite distance limits -- Part I: $g_s$ obstructions
summary: We analyse quantum obstructions to classical infinite distance limits in four-dimensional string compactifications with N=1 supersymmetry. Such quantum effects signal a severe departure from the perturbative effective action and can be of considerable importance for string model building. Our focus is on the complex structure moduli space of Type IIB orientifolds with O7/O3-planes and its F-theory description.
